build_text_model: build a TextTower model from a backbone config YAML file with head blocks and pooling
build_text_backbone: build a TextTransformer backbone from an OmegaConf config with specified dimensions and layers
create_text_head: create a TextHead module with causal self-attention blocks and optional linear projection
create_text_tower: create a TextTower module combining a backbone and head with first, last, or argmax pooling
init_text_head_weights: initialize TextHead weights using normal distribution for linear projection and block init
